response.sql: WITH station_counts AS (SELECT o.observstation, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count FROM observatories AS o LEFT JOIN telescopes AS t ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation), station_shares AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, CAST(telescope_count AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) AS share FROM station_counts), ranked AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY share DESC) AS share_rank FROM station_shares) SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share FROM ranked WHERE share_rank <= 10 ORDER BY share DESC, observstation;

assumptions.assumption: Every station in observatories is included, including stations with zero telescopes.
